data.long_meaning: The name Padvi is derived from the Sanskrit word 'pad' which means 'foot'. It is a diminutive form of the name Padmini, which means 'lotus-footed'. Another reference to the name 'Padvi' can be found in the 'Agni Purana', a Hindu scripture. In this text, Padvi is mentioned as one of the 18 'Vasus', or gods associated with material wealth.
